evidence: gitexec.go TreeFiles (line 592) runs git ls-tree -r --name-only -z on the landing commit's tree, so an untracked or deleted marker cannot hide a committed one.
gitexec.go Commit (line 198) resolves with rev-parse --verify <rev>^{commit}; an unresolvable revision is an error, not 'CI: none configured'.
CheckNoCI (engine/review/app/ci.go) answers no-CI only when every step succeeds; a marker or a remote is a refusal; no error is swallowed.
isCIMarker pins the five directories and ten files with near-miss tests at unit level and end to end.
cmd/review_ci.go prints 'CI: none configured' only after CheckNoCI returns nil.
The marker list is closed per S3 L123; providers outside it read as no CI, partly covered by the no-remote requirement; not a defect of this commit.
